title: Hamster holding a balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloon' cx='0.35' cy='0.3' r='0.8'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#ffb3d9'/>
      <stop offset='60%' stop-color='#ff4d94'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#d81b60'/>
    </radialGradient>
    <radialGradient id='fur' cx='0.4' cy='0.35' r='0.75'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#f6c777'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#cf8f2e'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- balloon string -->
  <path d='M62 38 Q66 55 58 68' stroke='#ffe8a3' stroke-width='1.6' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- balloon -->
  <ellipse cx='62' cy='24' rx='14' ry='16' fill='url(#balloon)'/>
  <path d='M59.5 39 L62 35 L64.5 39 Z' fill='#d81b60'/>
  <ellipse cx='56' cy='17' rx='4' ry='6' fill='#ffd6e8' opacity='0.8'/>

  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='66' rx='22' ry='20' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='71' rx='14' ry='12' fill='#fff1d4'/>

  <!-- feet -->
  <ellipse cx='34' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#e8a44b'/>
  <ellipse cx='57' cy='84' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#e8a44b'/>

  <!-- ears -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='7' fill='#cf8f2e'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ffb3c8'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='7' fill='#cf8f2e'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='38' r='4' fill='#ffb3c8'/>

  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='48' rx='21' ry='18' fill='url(#fur)'/>
  <!-- cheeks -->
  <circle cx='33' cy='53' r='5' fill='#ff9db8' opacity='0.85'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='53' r='5' fill='#ff9db8' opacity='0.85'/>

  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='46' rx='3' ry='3.8' fill='#2b1533'/>
  <ellipse cx='53' cy='46' rx='3' ry='3.8' fill='#2b1533'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='44.6' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='44.6' r='1.1' fill='#ffffff'/>

  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='46' cy='52' rx='2.6' ry='2' fill='#e06a8f'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 54.5 Q42.5 58 40 55.5 M46 54.5 Q49.5 58 52 55.5' stroke='#8a5230' stroke-width='1.3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- paw holding string -->
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='64' rx='6' ry='5' fill='#e8a44b'/>
  <ellipse cx='58' cy='64' rx='3' ry='2.4' fill='#ffd9a8'/>
</svg>
